reconcile.note: Fausset traces Adin's 201-person increase to the two registers being compiled years apart, in different places, amid attrition and Jewish naming customs.

discrepancy.note: Paine says the Ezra and Nehemiah return registers disagree family by family and neither register's own entries sum to its own stated total.

quotes.text: The list differs in several of the particulars from that of Ezra… These writers may do well enough for Bible-makers, but not for any thing where truth and exactness is necessary.
quotes.attr: Thomas Paine (d. 1809), The Age of Reason, Part II (1795), ch. I, on Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7.
